subject: PearlPoint partnership: technical gate & POC test plan
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@pearlpoint.ai>, eng@pearlpoint.ai
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: PearlPoint partnership: technical gate & POC test plan

Hi Marta / PearlPoint team,

Thanks for agreeing to proceed with the Tech Gate and POC. We want to make sure the integration is production-ready from both sides before the pilot. Attached is a proposed test plan (redwood-pearlpoint-test-plan.xlsx) and a compact checklist we run for partner connectors. Can you do the following ahead of our sync?

- Share a sample of the dataset you expect to send (anonymized) — ideally the top 5000 rows or a representative CSV.
- Confirm whether the integration will call Redwood via our hosted API or through a Dedicated/Private instance for the POC.
- Provide any network constraints (IP allowlist, proxy) and your expected peak QPS.

Proposed next steps:
1) Quick sync to align on topology and data flows (30m)
2) Exchange sample data and an architecture drawing
3) Run connectivity + baseline perf test (48h)
4) Execute scenario tests from the attached plan

Prefer to schedule the sync early next week — Tue/Wed morning PT works for us. Sergio and Karthik will own the technical checklist and infra setup; Laura will handle acceptance criteria.

Attachments in this thread: redwood-pearlpoint-test-plan.xlsx (spreadsheet, 45KB)

Thanks,

Priyom Das
Partner Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@pearlpoint.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: eng@pearlpoint.ai
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 18:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: PearlPoint partnership: technical gate & POC test plan

Hi Priyom — thanks for the clear plan. We're excited to move forward.

Quick answers:
- I attached our current POC architecture and a small sample export (pearlpoint-data-matrix.csv). The sample is redacted.
- For the POC we'd prefer to start against Redwood Hosted API (lowest friction) and then evaluate Dedicated if throughput needs demand it.
- IP allowlist is straightforward; we'll provide CIDR ranges. No proxy for the initial POC. Peak expected QPS: ~25-40 during peak batch windows.

We can do Tue 20 Apr at 10:00 PT — does that work? If yes, I'll send a calendar invite and invite our Eng lead (eng@pearlpoint.ai).

Attachments: pearlpoint_poc_arch.pdf (PDF, 210KB), pearlpoint-data-matrix.csv (CSV, 120KB)

Best,
Marta
Head of Integrations
PearlPoint AI

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@pearlpoint.ai>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PearlPoint partnership: technical gate & POC test plan

Marta — Tue 10:00 PT works, send the invite please. Thanks for the attachments; I skimmed the arch doc and the sample looks appropriate for baseline tests.

A few clarifications from our side (added inline):
- Hosted API for POC is fine. We'll provision a test API key with limited quota and scope.
- Karthik: please confirm we have a Canary pool available during 21-22 Apr for the initial perf run (25-40 QPS target).
- Security: we will need a completed vendor security questionnaire and SOC2 attestation PDF. Marta, can your compliance contact provide those by EOD Tue?
- Data handling: we'll use prefix-based KV caching for repeated prompts; please confirm whether PearlPoint will send user-identifying fields that must be redacted.

I've attached a short checklist below that we'll run during the sync and the 48h window after. If all items pass, we'll sign off on the Tech Gate and move to a short pilot.

Tech Gate checklist (summary):
- Connectivity (IP allowlist + TLS + auth)
- Sample ingestion sanity (schema + transforms)
- Baseline latency (p50/p95) against expected QPS
- Functional scenario pass/fail (10 core flows)
- Failure mode validation (fallbacks/queueing/backpressure)
- Security artifacts received

Thanks — see you on the call.

Priyom

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2026 11:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PearlPoint partnership: technical gate & POC test plan

Priyom / team — quick follow-up after reviewing Marta's architecture PDF. Points for the runbook: 

- Canary pool: confirmed. I reserved a two-node Canary pool on Hosted with GPU-backed instances for 21-22 Apr. I'll attach the ephemeral API key to the calendar event.
- Network: please ask PearlPoint to add 54.192.0.0/12 and 35.160.0.0/13 to allowlist for the test (we'll provide final IPs in the invite).
- Data: the sample file looks fine; note that the CSV schema has a free-text 'customer_notes' column — we should treat as PII. I recommend we enable redaction for that field during the POC.
- Instrumentation: we'll enable token-level tracing and a temporary metric stream to the partner dashboard. Expect p50 ~ 120ms and p95 ~ 420ms at 30 QPS in this config.
- Failure tests: I will simulate a backpressure window by throttling one node to validate PearlPoint's retry logic.

I'll post the short commands and the test-run checklist to the Drive link after the call.

Karthik
Senior Infra Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@pearlpoint.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, eng@pearlpoint.ai
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PearlPoint partnership: technical gate & POC test plan

Great sync today — thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. Summary and next steps: 

- Schedule: baseline perf window scheduled 21 Apr 22:00 UTC — Karthik will run the load script and watch traces; PearlPoint to send telemetry (simple webhook) to our test collector.
- Security: Marta to upload SOC2 and vendor questionnaire to the Drive link by EOD Fri (22 Apr).
- Data: PearlPoint confirmed hosted API for the POC; we'll apply redaction to 'customer_notes' and confirm in the results.
- Acceptance: if the 10 core flows pass and p95 latency remains within expected range, we sign the Tech Gate and proceed to a 4-week pilot.

Action owners: 
- Marta / PearlPoint: upload security artifacts + CIDRs (due 2026-04-22 EOD)
- Karthik: run perf + failure tests and share result sheet (due 2026-04-23)
- Laura: collate acceptance checklist and sign-off doc (due 2026-04-24)

I'll keep the HubSpot deal updated (ID PP-001) and loop in CS for pilot onboarding once Tech Gate is green.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Alliances
Redwood Inference
